findings.title: Normal evidence gate and packet DoD remain unsatisfied
findings.details: Independent protected-base-to-reviewed audit reports 38,263,916 bytes across 351 changed evidence/review blobs against the 16,777,216-byte PR budget and four retained plain artifacts above 262,144 bytes. Seventeen task commands and corrected HG049 protocol oracles have valid tested-SHA evidence, but this cannot establish all normal gates or completed DoD. The committed result accurately remains BLOCKED/UNMERGED; no runtime frozen-semantic defect or necessary SPEC_CHANGE_REQUIRED was found.
findings.required_change: Resolve the normal evidence-storage/history blocker through authorized work without truncation, waiver or historical rewriting; present a new reviewable revision and rerun SHA-bound independent review after the required normal gates and DoD pass.
